basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Public Health/Epidemiology/Health Management, including the integrated PG Degrees, with three years post-qualification experience, or PhD
qualification.details: Qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Public Health/Epidemiology/Health Management, including the integrated PG Degrees, with three years post-qualification experience; or PhD Experience: Three years post-qualification experience (with the PG Degree option); experience should have been gained after acquiring the minimum essential qualification Age limit: Maximum 40 years (as on date of Walk-In-Interview i.e. date of interview) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PWD As per government rules | Other conditions: | Qualification and experience should be in relevant discipline/field and from an Institution of repute Experience should have been gained after acquiring the minimum essential qualification | Desirable: | Experience in implementation research will be given preference Experience in project report writing skills Manuscript writing skills Knowledge of computer applications

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form provided in the notice (pages 4 to 7).
Attend the walk-in interview on 12-11-2026 (tentative), reporting between 10 AM and 11 AM at Room No-317, 3rd Floor, CM&FM Department, Academic Building, AIIMS Bhubaneswar.
Bring the filled-in form with original documents, self-attested photocopies of certificates and a passport-size photograph.
Submit a separate application for each post.
important_instructions: Walk-in date is tentative Corrigendum/addendum/further information will be published on the AIIMS website only Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification Wrong or false information shall disqualify the candidature at any stage Candidates failing to bring originals at joining will not be allowed to join; post goes to waiting list

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Public Health/Epidemiology/Health Management, including the integrated PG Degrees, with three years post-qualification experience; or PhD Experience: Three years post-qualification experience (with the PG Degree option); experience should have been gained after acquiring the minimum essential qualification Age limit: Maximum 40 years (as on date of Walk-In-Interview i.e. date of interview) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PWD As per government rules Other conditions: Qualification and experience should be in relevant discipline/field and from an Institution of repute Experience should have been gained after acquiring the minimum essential qualification Desirable: Experience in implementation research will be given preference Experience in project report writing skills Manuscript writing skills Knowledge of computer applications

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department/Organizations

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary contract appointment basis Tenure 5 months, to be renewed based on satisfactory performance and availability of funds Engagement can be terminated by one month notice on either side No claim on a regular post; PF, Pension, LTC, Medical claim not admissible; undertaking at joining

content_sections.heading: How Will AIIMS Bhubaneswar Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview (offline mode) Interview conducted through offline mode only Engagement for a particular position decided by selection committee/appointing authority

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled-in application form Original documents Self-attested photocopies of certificates Passport-size photograph

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form provided in the notice (pages 4 to 7). Attend the walk-in interview on 12-11-2026 (tentative), reporting between 10 AM and 11 AM at Room No-317, 3rd Floor, CM&FM Department, Academic Building, AIIMS Bhubaneswar. Bring the filled-in form with original documents, self-attested photocopies of certificates and a passport-size photograph. Submit a separate application for each post.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 12 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 12 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Room No-317, 3rd Floor, CM&FM Department, Academic Building, AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years (as on date of Walk-In-Interview i.e. date of interview). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PWD As per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 67,000 + 20% HRA = Rs. 80,400 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate Degree in Public Health/Epidemiology/Health Management, including the integrated PG Degrees, with three years post-qualification experience, or PhD.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Qualification and experience should be in relevant discipline/field and from an Institution of repute. Experience should have been gained after acquiring the minimum essential qualification.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department/Organizations.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview (offline mode). Interview conducted through offline mode only. Engagement for a particular position decided by selection committee/appointing authority.
